name: What should I prepare before a drywall contractor arrives for a repair?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before a drywall contractor arrives for a repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before a contractor arrives, clear furniture, floor decor, and wall hangings at least three to four feet away from the work area. Move fragile belongings out of the room, as sanding joint compound creates fine airborne dust. It is also helpful to identify whether you have leftover touch-up paint from the original wall installation, including the brand, color name, and sheen. Providing the existing paint code simplifies color matching and speeds up the transition from patched drywall to completed finish coat.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear nearby furniture and fragile items away from the work area to provide space and manage dust. Have your original paint can or color code ready for seamless touch-up painting.
